title: API: change refuses tracking on with no bins, keeps bins on a price-only change and keeps Min/Max when left out
custom_preconds:
• API calls replayed from DevTools with header X-Location-ID = your location.
  • An untracked part with no bins (U) and a tracked part with Min 1 / Max 15 (T).
custom_steps:
1. POST /api/inventory/parts/change for U with isTracked true and bins [].
  2. GET U.
  3. POST change for U with isTracked false, bins [] and only purchasePrice changed (e.g. 1.75).
  4. GET U and open its Part History.
  5. POST change for T with min and max left out of the body.
  6. GET /api/inventory/parts?search={T number}.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • 400 "At least one bin must be provided."

Step 2:

  • Nothing changed: isTracked false, no bins.

Step 3:

  • 201.

Step 4:

  • Cost updated; bins and quantity untouched; history has "Average cost updated" and no inventory change entry.

Step 5:

  • 201.

Step 6:

  • min 1 and max 15 are kept, not zeroed.
